rollout_goal: Start with file-based evidence and enable API adapters progressively without changing safety gate logic.

api_enablement_sequence.name: File Evidence
api_enablement_sequence.description: Client supplies evidence files or exports. No API dependency.

api_enablement_sequence.name: Priority Pull Adapters
api_enablement_sequence.description: Enable only high-value APIs such as ITSM change and observability SLO.

api_enablement_sequence.name: Full Adapter Coverage
api_enablement_sequence.description: Add cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git, AWX adapters for richer evidence.

client_inputs_needed: Which ITSM tool and change/incident tables are authoritative?
Which observability platform owns SLO/error budget?
Which source owns desired infrastructure state: Terraform, GitOps, cloud config, CMDB?
Which automation runner is used: Ansible CLI, AWX, Ansible Automation Platform?
Where is rollback metadata stored: SLM/bak, Git, artifact repository, backup system?
Which tags identify service/environment/resource across systems?
